name: LYEINANI starter Q&A set
usage: If a user question matches one of these (by question or any variant), return the stored answer directly. Anything else is answered by RAG over the scraped site PDFs.

qa_pairs.question: What is LYEINANI?
variants: What kind of clothes do you sell?
qa_pairs.answer: LYEINANI is an urban clothing brand with contemporary styles inspired by anime, pop culture, and different cultures. The collections reflect the transition from adolescence to adulthood. You can meet the designer on our About page.

qa_pairs.question: What collections do you have?
qa_pairs.answer: Current collections include the JJK Collection and the Tokyo 1992 Collection, plus Fresh Drops for new releases and a Sale section. You can also shop by category: tops, blazers, bottoms, bodysuits, and dresses.

qa_pairs.question: How do I contact you?
variants: How can I reach customer service?
qa_pairs.answer: Email info@lyeinaniofficial.com with your order number, or use the Contact Me form on the site. You can also find LYEINANI on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook as @lyeinani.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell gift cards?
variants: Can I buy a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. The Bad Waifu e-gift card is available on the site. Note that gift cards can't be returned.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer refunds?
variants: Can I get my money back?
qa_pairs.answer: Refunds are only given when an item has a merchandise defect. For other issues, we offer exchanges under the exchange policy. Please read the return policy before you buy.

qa_pairs.question: How long do I have to request an exchange?
variants: How many days do I have to return something?
qa_pairs.answer: Submit your exchange claim within 15 business days of delivery. Claims after that window can't be accepted.

qa_pairs.question: What condition does an item need to be in for an exchange?
variants: Can I exchange something I wore?
qa_pairs.answer: Items must be unworn and unwashed, with all original tags attached. They also need to be free of odors, stains, makeup, pet hair, and damage.

qa_pairs.question: Can I return or exchange sale items?
variants: Can I exchange something I bought on sale?
qa_pairs.answer: No. Sale items are final sale because they're discounted to clear limited stock.

qa_pairs.question: Can international orders be returned?
variants: I'm outside the US, can I return my order?
qa_pairs.answer: No. All international orders are final, with no returns or exchanges.

qa_pairs.question: What do I do if my item is defective or wrong?
variants: There's a defect in my order
qa_pairs.answer: Contact us right away at info@lyeinaniofficial.com with your order number and photos of the item, the packaging (inside and outside), and the delivery slip. Keep the delivery slip.

qa_pairs.question: How do I start a return or exchange?
variants: How do I file a claim?
Where do I send a return request?
qa_pairs.answer: Email info@lyeinaniofficial.com with your order number and a detailed explanation of the issue. LYEINANI pays for return shipping. Original shipping fees are non-refundable.

qa_pairs.question: Who pays for return shipping?
variants: Do I have to pay to ship my exchange back?
qa_pairs.answer: LYEINANI pays for return shipping on eligible exchanges. The original shipping fee from your order is non-refundable.

qa_pairs.question: Can I exchange a preorder item?
variants: Can I change the size of my preorder?
My preorder doesn't fit, can I exchange it?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, preorder items can be exchanged if your size is available. The standard exchange rules still apply: submit your claim within 15 business days of delivery, with the item unworn, unwashed, and tags attached.

qa_pairs.question: How long does it take to process my order?
qa_pairs.answer: Orders take 2-3 business days to process. Once your order ships, you'll get a confirmation email with tracking details. Preorders follow their own timelines, posted on the PRETA page.

qa_pairs.question: Do you ship internationally?
variants: Can I order from outside the US?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, LYEINANI ships worldwide. Canadian orders go through UPS, DHL Express, or FedEx. Keep in mind that international orders are final sale.

qa_pairs.question: How much is shipping?
qa_pairs.answer: Shipping rates depend on things like whether your order is domestic or international. Your exact shipping cost, taxes, and estimated transit time are shown at checkout.

qa_pairs.question: Who pays customs fees or duties?
qa_pairs.answer: Customs fees and duties are the customer's responsibility. LYEINANI isn't responsible for customs fees for any reason.

qa_pairs.question: I entered the wrong address. What should I do?
variants: Can I change my shipping address?
qa_pairs.answer: Email info@lyeinaniofficial.com with your order number as soon as possible. Orders can't be changed or canceled once they've shipped, so double-check your address, including apartment or unit number, before checkout.

qa_pairs.question: My package was lost or stolen. What can I do?
variants: Tracking says delivered but I don't have it
qa_pairs.answer: Contact us with your order number. If tracking shows the package was lost in transit, or it was returned to sender and we received it, we may issue store credit minus shipping costs.

qa_pairs.question: How do I track my order?
variants: Where can I find my tracking number?
qa_pairs.answer: Your tracking details are in the shipping confirmation email and in your LYEINANI account. For preorders, check the PRETA status page for production and shipping updates.

qa_pairs.question: How do preorders work, and where can I check their status?
qa_pairs.answer: PRETA is our preorder status page, and it explains the process for every preorder item. As a general estimate, preorders take about 8-11 weeks: production averages 4-6 weeks, customs takes about 20 days, and shipping takes 1-2 weeks. These are estimates, not guarantees. Manufacturing, holidays, and customs can shift them, and confirmed changes are posted on PRETA. For a specific order, contact us with your order number.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer custom design or brand support services?
variants: Can you help me start a clothing brand?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. Brand Support covers tech packs, manufacturer sourcing, factory communication, quote and invoice review, shipping and logistics, and design direction. It starts with a non-refundable $150, 30-minute consultation: submit a request, pay the fee, and you'll be emailed available dates. Additional work starts at $70/hour, and tech packs run $300-$800, with scope agreed on during the consultation. Please don't send actual designs with your first request.
